Soft, clean, and effortlessly elegant, Signature Musk is a fragrance built around smooth musky warmth with a modern, refined finish. Fresh airy notes create a light and comforting opening before the scent settles into a soft blend of white musk, warm woods, and creamy undertones that feel intimate and long-lasting on the skin.

Minimal yet luxurious, Signature Musk is designed for those who appreciate subtle sophistication and fragrances that leave a clean, smooth, and comforting trail without overpowering the senses.

Olfactive Notes
Top — Fresh Airy Accords
Heart — White Musk, Soft Florals
Base — Creamy Woods, Amber, Musk
